entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often by attaching a different conditioning encoder, latent space, or control channel to an existing refinement backbone and presenting the swap itself as the contribution, without isolating it. The recurring structural shortcut is the missing ablation that holds backbone, data, and compute fixed while toggling only the new interface — so reviewers cannot tell whether the gain comes from the redesigned conditioning pathway or from a stronger borrowed encoder, more data, or more compute.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Eliminating two inherited bottlenecks at once is only compelling if the combined system clearly beats systems that removed each in isolation; marginal gains plus a regression in primary quality read as recombination, not a new method.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The proposed interface jointly changes point-bound token content, variable program topology, and active-token phase injection, while the listed arms do not cleanly isolate those subchanges, although they are presented as one functional interface rather than two unrelated bottleneck fixes.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Swapping the conditioning encoder for a more powerful one is not a new model class if the output quality still trails incumbents and the encoder's advantage is never ablated against the prior encoder under matched conditions.

entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often when the constructed instrument isolates the confound only inside an artificial regime and never demonstrates that the isolated signal transfers to real deployment conditions — the synthetic-to-real gap is asserted rather than shown. A second recurring shape is circularity: the diagnostic is validated against the same definition, assumption, or system population it was built to interrogate (using the evaluated models as their own oracle, or hardcoding a contested definition of the target property), so it cannot independently confirm what it claims.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data, without demonstrating that the controlled finding transfers to real-world instances, leaves ecological validity unestablished and undermines the central claim.

reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: Policy-independent contact/program labels construct the matched subset, while full-task success, first-contact correctness, phase-order error, and collisions provide downstream outcomes independent of the evaluated policy's own judgment.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Resting an unsupervised evaluation on the unverified premise that the systems under test can reliably judge one another stakes the entire method on an assumption that collapses under scrutiny.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: Neither the evaluated policies nor peer model consensus supply the diagnostic oracle; MuJoCo contacts and pre-registered human labels do.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Pairing a single-task or small-sample instrument with broad capability claims triggers a scope-mismatch rejection, and assembling retrieval or engineering blocks without an isolating scientific insight reads as application rather than research.
